hookups.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/finley-point ('18 RV campsites with electricity') + ReserveAmerica campsite details for sites 014 (siteId 168, Lower Loop) and 001 (siteId 155, Upper Loop): 'Electricity Hookup: 50'; the site list marks every electric site 'Full Hookup - no', read 2026-10-22

values.note: 18 RV campsites with electricity (one wheelchair accessible) and 7 walk-in tent-only sites, plus 2 cabins, 4 camping boat slips with electricity and 14 boat slips. FWP: 'The maximum RV/trailer length is 40 feet'; on ReserveAmerica the electric sites are all back-in, 30-50 ft (the six Lower Loop sites 45-50 ft and lakefront).

note: MT FWP unit of Flathead Lake State Park on the SE shore of Flathead Lake, 12 mi N of Polson, in open ponderosa pine forest. Inside the Flathead Reservation: recreation on tribal land outside the park needs a tribal recreation permit, and fishing the southern half of the lake a tribal licence. The dock is unusable at low lake level (typically usable mid-June to early September). --Claude
summary: FWP page + ReserveAmerica: confirmed 25 sites (18 electric RV + 7 walk-in tent), 40-ft max RV/trailer, reservable on ReserveAmerica (derived values now verified); added 50-amp electric (no full hookups), no pull-throughs, vault toilets and seasonal water. Campground season (April-October) already manual; fees left as recorded (the park page gives only the statewide $4-$34 range). Booking window/cutoff/7-night limit not stated on the park page, left inherited. Note trimmed of restated values.
